checks: Repeated debug/release named outcomes; compiled assertion mutant; exact restore; paired syntax
cost: Clone traverses owned tree vectors/boxes and strings, O(owned nodes+text), but Rc body/function references clone O(1). text is O(1). No recursion depth cap.
description: Expr is a tagged recursive sum: Num/Imag retain value and spelling, Str retains quote mode, Binary retains BinOp, Range retains optional step, Index retains argument order, AnonFn retains Rc body. Stmt stores one-based lexer line plus print/op metadata. Program partitions top-level statements and Rc function definitions.

inverse: The representation relation excludes clone changing tags, ordered children, names or literal payload. BinOp::Pow and EPow are distinct even where scalar execution agrees. It does not exclude a hand-constructed invalid assignment or nonsensical line number; enums do not enforce grammar or evaluation.

Given an Expr, compatible source strings are all texts parsed to its retained tags/payload; whitespace/comments are not uniquely recoverable. Clone's antecedent is any structurally equal tree; Rc anonymous-body cloning additionally retains pointer identity, not a fresh allocation. Runtime values cannot recover arbitrary syntax.
limitations: Partial lexical syntax, no semantic proof or executable surrogate
Finite enum trees and ordered vectors; f64 payload permits NaN/Infinity. Public construction does not certify well-formed programs. No I/O or GPU effects.
